subject: VantagePoint GRC bridge — activation checklist and SOW
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@vantagepointsec.com>
To: connor.obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: contracts@vantagepointsec.com
Date: 2026-11-15T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Proposal: GRC bridge activation and pen-test intake workflow

Hi Connor —

Thanks for the quick intake call last week. Attached are the draft SOW and our estimated pen-test scope. High level: we propose a two-phase engagement where VantagePoint will provision a connector into Redwood Console (read-only evidence pull via API), run a scoped penetration test, and then hand off continuous evidence sync to our managed GRC feed.

Key asks from our side before kickoff:
- A short API token with read-only scope for the "connector-read" role (TTL: 30d)
- Confirmation of artifact types you want pulled (logs, release notes, infra-config, SOC2 attachments)
- Any IP allowlist / firewall info for the discovery lambda

Proposed kickoff: Wed Nov 18, 10:00am PT — 30 min. If that works, we'll send a calendar invite and a DocuSign link for the SOW.

Attachments: VantagePoint-SOW-v1.pdf, VantagePoint-Pentest-Scope.xlsx

Best,
Alex Chen
Partnerships Lead | VantagePoint Security
alex.chen@vantagepointsec.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

--
Note: This email references a draft SOW and scope spreadsheet. All attachments are summaries and subject to final redlines.

From: connor.obrien@redwood.ai
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@vantagepointsec.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-15T11:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: GRC bridge activation and pen-test intake workflow

Alex — thanks for the materials, looked over both attachments. Quick answers and next steps below.

Answers to your asks:
- API token: we can create a scoped service token with a "connector-read" role. Security prefers rotating tokens; can we set up a short-lived token issued via our connector onboarding endpoint? If not, we can provide a 30d token and rotate on completion of the engagement.
- Artifact types: primary set we want initially: (1) SOC2 attachments (control evidence PDFs), (2) infra-config snapshots (Terraform state exports), (3) audit logs (authn/authz events), (4) release notes tagged with release IDs. We can add application logs in phase 2.
- IP allowlist: our discovery lambda will originate from 3 static egress IPs — we can share those CIDRs after legal review (cc kimberly).

Proposed changes to SOW: can you add an optional clause for automated evidence mapping into Redwood Console fields (control_id -> evidence_type) and a deliverable for a short mapping table? Also add a clause about data retention for pulled artifacts (default 90 days unless otherwise requested).

We can do the kickoff Wed 11/18 at 10am PT. Marcus will own procurement and SOW redlines; Kimberly will own the security checklist and IP/addressing. I'll host the meeting.

Next: please send DocuSign link and we will route the SOW through procurement. Also include the technical contact for the pen-test manager (name + PGP key if available).

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai
+1 (206) 555-0122

Confirmed: we received the DocuSign envelope and procurement will generate a PO today (Marcus is looping finance). A couple of operational notes before kickoff:

Action list (mutual):
- Redwood: create scoped connector role and issue short-lived onboarding token (Connor) — target: 11/18 08:00 PT
- Redwood Security: share three CIDR blocks for allowlist and provide a short checklist for the discovery lambda (Kimberly) — target: 11/17 EOD
- VantagePoint: provide Priya's PGP key and scheduled discovery window times (Alex) — target: 11/17 EOD
- Procurement: complete DocuSign + PO and confirm billing contact (Marcus) — target: 11/17 EOD

I've logged a ticket in our tracker: https://redwoodinc.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4721 (INF-4721) to track onboarding tasks and delivery milestones. Please use that ticket for any technical threads so we keep the audit trail tied to the engagement.

We will run the kickoff cadence as: 30m kickoff (scope + tech owners), 60m discovery runbook call (if needed), and a 15m post-test sync for initial findings.

Thanks everyone — see you on 11/18 at 10:00am PT.
